concept.hr: zonu paketa određuje njegova izvorišna adresa ili sučelje
concept.en: a packet's zone comes from its source or its interface

summary.hr: Pošalji paket s druge adrese ili kroz drugo sučelje: prvo se bira zona, a tek ona odlučuje hoće li ga prihvatiti, odbiti ili odbaciti.
summary.en: Send a packet from another address or through another interface: the zone is chosen first, and only the zone decides to accept, reject or drop.

title.en: The source address before the interface

concept.hr: vezivanje izvora odlučuje prije zone sučelja kroz koje je paket ušao
concept.en: a source binding decides before the zone of the interface the packet came in on

title.hr: drop ili block: tišina ili odbijenica
title.en: drop or block: silence or a reject

concept.hr: odbačen paket izgleda kao ugašen stroj, odbijen dobiva odgovor
concept.en: a dropped packet looks like a host that is down; a rejected one gets a reply
